source_row.rationale: Postoperative atelectasis can produce dyspnea and decreased breath sounds, especially with shallow ventilation and immobility. Lung-expansion measures and mobilization may be used as clinically appropriate. Fever should not be used as a defining cue because evidence does not support atelectasis as a cause of postoperative fever.
source_row.source_detail: Postoperative atelectasis: dyspnea/reduced breath sounds may occur; supportive lung-expansion measures are used; importantly, evidence does not support atelectasis as a cause of postoperative fever; accessed 2026-08-14.
